Question 4
?

Find a vector equation of the straight line passing through P(3,−2,5) and parallel to v=⟨4,1,6⟩.

a
r=⟨6,4,1⟩+t⟨3,−2,5⟩,t∈(−∞,∞)
b
r=⟨3,−2,5⟩+t⟨4,1,6⟩,t∈(−∞,∞)
c
r=⟨5,−2,3⟩+t⟨6,4,1⟩,t∈(−∞,∞)
d
r=⟨4,1,6⟩+⟨3,−2,5⟩
e
r=⟨4,1,6⟩+t⟨3,−2,5⟩,t∈(−∞,∞)
